sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "matches"."winner_id" AS e, "players"."hand" AS g, AVG("matches"."winner_ht") AS m1 FROM "matches" JOIN "players" ON "players"."player_id" = "matches"."winner_id"  GROUP BY "matches"."winner_id", "players"."hand"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: average of winner height per players within players.hand
gap to the all average of average of winner height (all level)
rank within the group by average of winner height, keep the top 3

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "rankings"."player_id" AS e, "players"."hand" AS g, SUM("rankings"."tours") AS m1 FROM "rankings" JOIN "players" ON "players"."player_id" = "rankings"."player_id"  GROUP BY "rankings"."player_id", "players"."hand"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: total of tournaments played per players within players.hand (additive)
share of the all total of total of tournaments played (all level)
rank within the group by total of tournaments played: share of the all total, keep the top 3
